## What and why

One or two sentences. Fixes #

## Checklist

- [ ] `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` pass
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test that fails without it
- [ ] User-facing strings are in `lib/i18n/strings_en.i18n.json` (then `dart run slang`)
- [ ] A user-visible change has a line under `Unreleased` in `assets/release_notes.yaml`
- [ ] The PR title is a Conventional Commits line (`type(scope): subject`) - it becomes the squashed commit
